verdict.rationale: Rippling publishes a documented public v2 REST API at rest.ripplingapis.com. The docs cover Bearer API tokens with scopes, OAuth 2.0 for partner apps, dated version pinning via the Rippling-Api-Version header, cursor-based pagination, a first-call quickstart and an official npm SDK. A probe confirmed the developer llms.txt is live. Missing for 10: evidence that the API covers the IT-specific modules (devices, identity/access, inventory), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the IT product through the API.
